about.title: Tuqit
about.intro: {project} ukax mä machaq jach'a peer-to-peer taqi chimpu lakiña plataforma, jichha pacha tecnologianakanjam lurata, janiwa taypichat. Mä apnaqirinakar suma yäqasiri interfaz uka apnaqaña arquitectura janiwa taypichat ukamp mayachthapi, mä k'umara ukamp aljañ utt'aña waki suma luräwiñataki datusanak lakiñataki, janiwa kuna taypir munañ apnaqasit. Aka proyectox open source ukamp utji ukamp {license} manqhanjamax irpata.

decentralized.title: Phuqhata janiwa taypichat sayt'añanak
decentralized.description: Janiwa taypi servidornakax utji, janiwa mä cheqaw urmañataki utji. Apnaqirinakax mä ratuw kunjamtix luräwinakar thaqhapxi ukamp aynacharu apsupxi pampaki taypipan, janiwa taypir indexador, tracker jan ukax base de datusanakar amparat'asisin.

accessControl.title: Sumat sumat mantañ apnaqaña
accessControl.description: Taqpach jaqinakax k'umaraw paypach sayt'añap qalltañataki paypach kamachinakapanjam. Apnaqirinakan apnaqäwinakapax mayni mayni sayt'añanakan amuyawisita: dueñunaka, admin, willjayirinaka, moderator ukamp aynachar apsurinaka. Suma apnaqaña khitis willjayispa, moderar ukamp aynacharu apsuspa luräwinak.

ui.title: Apnaqirin sumakipanaka interfaz
ui.description: Mä q'uma ukamp suma apnaqasiri media center interfaz computadora, TV ukamp celular wakichawi. K'achata sarnaqa teclado, ratón, gamepad jan ukax control remoto ukanakamp. Yatxatat apnaqirinakax línea de comando interfaz apnaqasipxaspa software apnaqaña kunjamtix mä jan p'iqi servidor luräwiñataki.

dataFormat.title: Jaqit ullasiri formato datus
dataFormat.description: LISH datusan formatupax JSON ukan utt'ayata, ukax k'umaraw lurañataki, ullarañataki ukamp amuyañataki. Luräwinaka lakipxam q'uma, qhana metadatamp, kawkin jaqis suma uñakipispa.

security.title: Imantasiña ukamp k'umara
security.description: Taqpach peer-to-peer aruskipt'awinakax cifrarata, datusan imantat ukar uñacht'ayi apaña pachan. Apnaqirinakax VPN qhipanakar imantasipxaspa mä juk'amp jan uñt'añ ukar. {project} ukax imantasiñam yäqi luräwiparuwa.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Software ukax Windows, Linux ukamp macOS plataformanakatakix utji. Apnaqam kunayman munat irnaqäwinakar.

download.title: Aynacharu apsuña
download.description: {project} ukax plataformaman jaq'tasim. Taqpach aynacharu apsuwinakax inaki ukamp open source.

macos.title: Wali wakiskir qillqa macOS apnaqirinakatakixa:
macos.intro: macOS Gatekeeper ukax janiwa firmat / janiwa notarizat apps internetat aynacharu apsutanakar jark'i {error} pantjasita.
macos.runCommand: DMG jan ukax ZIP aynacharu apsutax, app jist'aratasinkam akham mantäwi Terminal ukan irnaqayam:
macos.explanation: Akax cuarentena t'aqa apaqi ukamp app irnaqañar jaq'tayi.
